en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, per the note the first recorded Macedonian folk song (Kostur, 16th century); archaic Kostur dialect. 'зарви ме' and 'дарви ме' are my reading ('embrace me', 'grant it to me') and 'станви' is a guess.

lines.en: By God, girl,
what do they call you by name?

lines.cyr: О, друшко, ле, жиф ти очи,
lines.lat: O, druško, le, žif ti oči,
lines.en: Oh, friend, oh, may your eyes live,
come here, embrace me,
Your kiss,
I beg you, grant it to me.

lines.cyr: Што си лепа, што си, ле, бела,
lines.lat: Što si lepa, što si, le, bela,
lines.en: How beautiful you are, how white, oh,

lines.cyr: Што си бела, што те љубам девојко!
lines.lat: Što si bela, što te ljubam devojko!
lines.en: How white you are, how I love you, girl!
Come, my comfort,
so that I may kiss you on the mouth,
You smell to me like the fruit
that the pear tree bore,
By the Most High God,
Do not take my soul.

lines.cyr: Што си лепа, што си ле бела,
lines.lat: Što si lepa, što si le bela,
lines.en: How beautiful you are, how white, oh,

lines.cyr: Што си бела, што те љубам девојко!
lines.lat: Što si bela, što te ljubam devojko!
lines.en: How white you are, how I love you, girl!
How long, my little heart,
shall we kiss in secret,
With enormous fears,
wasting our days,
Come, get up, damn it, come,
let us take each other.

lines.cyr: Што си лепа, што си ле бела,
lines.lat: Što si lepa, što si le bela,
lines.en: How beautiful you are, how white, oh,

lines.cyr: Што си бела, што те љубам девојко!
lines.lat: Što si bela, što te ljubam devojko!
lines.en: How white you are, how I love you, girl!
